title: alchemilla alpestris subsp. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla alpestris subsp. obtusa, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it a promising natural remedy for wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla alpestris subsp. obtusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
